name: Dawn Ward
text: Frost. Gain 10 Barrier. Consume. Opening hand.

name: Hail Chant
text: At the end of your turn: If you have a Bear: Apply 1 Faltering to ALL enemies. Gain 4 Barrier.

name: Consuming Dusk
text: Plant 2 Moon Owls. At the end of your turn: Command your front totem.

name: Storm Chant
text: Whenever you play an Aura: Gain 1 Mana. Plant a Thunderbird.

name: Blighted Chorus
text: Storm. Deal 5 damage to a random enemy 2 times, 1 more time per Status card in your deck.

name: Swift Strike
text: Storm. Deal 5 damage. If you have played 2 or fewer other cards this turn: Draw 1 card.

name: Shattering Call
text: Storm. Deal 7 damage to ALL enemies. Command every totem, front to back twice. Consume.

name: Thunder Rush
text: Storm. Plant a Thunderbird X times.

name: Spark Strike
text: Storm. Deal 3 (+4 per Thunderbird you have) damage.

name: Thunder Beam
text: Storm. Deal 28 damage to ALL enemies. Lose 3 Spirit.

name: Swift Study
text: Storm. Draw 3 cards.

name: Thunder Chant
text: For the rest of the fight, a Thunderbird you command deals 5 more damage (its end-of-turn effect is not changed).

name: Hurried Prayer
text: Draw 2 cards. Add a Void to your discard pile. Consume.

name: Harmonize
text: Gain Spirit equal to 2 times the kinds of totem you have until the end of your turn. Consume.

name: Double Rite
text: Gain Mana equal to your Mana. Consume.

name: Burnt Offering
text: Consume 1 card. Next turn, gain 2 extra Mana.

name: Echoing Spirit
text: The first card you play each turn is played an extra time. Fleeting.

name: Hawk Banner
text: At the start of your turn: Plant a Hawk.

name: Wellspring
text: Gain 4 Mana. Consume.

name: Doubled Vow
text: Your next Aura is played an extra time. Consume.

name: Free Hand
text: Your 0-cost Attacks deal 3 more damage for the rest of the fight.

name: Chain of Calls
text: Command your front totem X times.

name: Salvage Spirit
text: Whenever you create a Status card: Plant a random totem.

name: Snap Back
text: The first time you play a 0-cost Attack each turn: Return it to your hand.

name: Bitter Lesson
text: The first time you draw a Status card each turn: Draw 2 cards.

name: Turning Wheel
text: At the start of your turn: Your front totem's end-of-turn effect happens now.

name: Ward of the Spirits
text: The next time you would lose HP, you lose none instead.

name: Wild Vision
text: Add a random Aura card from your pool to your hand (it costs 0 this turn). Consume.

name: Kindling Ward
text: Gain 6 Barrier. Turn every Status card in your hand into a Tinder (0-cost: Gain 1 Mana. Consume).

name: Fresh Start
text: Shuffle your hand and discard pile into your draw pile. Draw 4 cards. Consume.

name: Thunder Memory
text: Plant a Thunderbird for each Thunderbird you have planted this fight. Consume.

name: Harvest of Ruin
text: Add 3 Wounds to your discard pile. Draw 2 cards.
